description: 转绘短剧工厂：抽帧看片 → 风格本土化 → 剧本分镜 → 资产分配 → 分镜图 → 视频生成的端到端流水线，无限画布承载

tools.name: redraw_open
tools.description: 启动/复用本地画布服务并返回浏览器 URL

tools.name: redraw_get_state
tools.description: 读取流程进度、门控、计数、任务与选中状态

tools.name: redraw_config_get
tools.description: 读取工作区配置（密钥脱敏）与适配文件列表

tools.name: redraw_config_set
tools.description: 写入供应商/模型/密钥/信任配置

tools.name: redraw_vendor_list
tools.description: 列出工作区供应商适配文件及其模型

tools.name: redraw_vendor_validate
tools.description: 校验供应商适配文件能否加载

tools.name: redraw_style_list
tools.description: 列出内置与自定义转绘风格

tools.name: redraw_style_set
tools.description: 锁定项目级转绘风格

tools.name: redraw_frames_ingest
tools.description: 接收视频素材或文本剧情

tools.name: redraw_frames_extract
tools.description: 提交抽帧请求（浏览器 ffmpeg.wasm 执行）

tools.name: redraw_frames_list
tools.description: 列出抽帧结果与宫格总览图路径

tools.name: redraw_localize_set
tools.description: 记录目标地区与结构化本土化报告

tools.name: redraw_localize_get
tools.description: 读取本土化报告

tools.name: redraw_script_upsert
tools.description: 写入/修订剧本草稿

tools.name: redraw_script_get
tools.description: 读取当前剧本

tools.name: redraw_script_approve
tools.description: 批准剧本

tools.name: redraw_shotlist_upsert
tools.description: 写入/修订分镜表

tools.name: redraw_shotlist_get
tools.description: 读取当前分镜表

tools.name: redraw_shotlist_approve
tools.description: 批准分镜表

tools.name: redraw_assets_upsert
tools.description: 写入资产设定、提示词与变体

tools.name: redraw_assets_list
tools.description: 列出资产、变体与图片路径

tools.name: redraw_assets_generate
tools.description: 生成资产基础图或变体图

tools.name: redraw_boards_plan
tools.description: 记录分镜图类型与宫格偏好

tools.name: redraw_boards_generate
tools.description: 生成分镜图（单帧/首尾帧/宫格）

tools.name: redraw_video_generate
tools.description: 为镜头生成一段视频（逐段不拼接）

tools.name: redraw_job_status
tools.description: 查询任务状态与产出路径

tools.name: redraw_job_cancel
tools.description: 取消进行中的任务

tools.name: redraw_add_edge
tools.description: 在画布上为两个节点连线
